description: This file contains functional web tests for the Basket Index page in an ASP.NET Core application, specifically testing updating item quantities in the shopping cart.

classes.name: IndexTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying basket functionalities such as updating item quantities and emptying the basket.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo50Successfully
methods.description: Test that updates the quantity of an item in the basket to 49 and verifies the total amount.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo0EmptyBasket
methods.description: Test that sets an item's quantity to zero and verifies the basket is emptied.
